title: LEMURS SSI: Evaluation of Behavioral Incentives
official: Lived Experiences Measured Using Ring Study: Single Session Intervention to Motivate Behavioral Change
summary: The goal of this substudy is to determine if a brief single-session-intervention (SSI) coupled with different incentive strategies to support engaging in wellness-related activities.
